full_judgment: 3. Briefly stated the case of the plaintiff is that the land of Mouza Uttar Amragacia of SA Khatian No. 366 measuring an area of 0.20 decimals sold to defendant Amzad Hossain son of late Khadem Ali Hawlader by registered sale deed dated 27-3-1967 and on the same day an Ekrarnama was executed between the parties to reconvey the said land. This Ekrarnama deed is a Khai Khalashi deed under section 95(A) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act and after promulgation of President Order No.88 of 72 and 136 of 72 land automatically redempt and plaintiff has been possessing the land. It was further stated in the plaint that the plaintiff asked the defendant to execute the return kabala in favour of the plaintiff, but the defendant refused to execute the return kabala finally on 24 Agrahaon, 1412 BS corresponding to 12-12-2005. Thus the plaintiff was constrained to file the present suit.
